## Release scope

Maris 0.2.2 provides portable CLI/TUI packages for macOS, Linux and Windows on x86_64 and ARM64. The distribution follows the existing CLI software release contract: exact-source native checks, offline regression rounds, package integrity checks, isolated installation and upgrade/recovery checks, followed by public installer checks before stable promotion.

These packages are unsigned and have no publisher-signing or macOS notarization claim. Software and installation checks do not establish successful operation on a particular physical audio device or subjective sound quality.

## Known limits and unfinished work

- Physical capture, original-audio muting/restoration, multiple-device clocks, device and power transitions, output loudness and subjective listening acceptance remain unverified. The previously reported Mac Pro no-sound symptom has not been confirmed resolved on the affected hardware.
- The release does not claim completion of the separate GUI application acceptance or signing requirements. Existing hardware and listening work remains open.
- CPAL/Flexaudio migration is not included. The locked dependency graph still reports four maintenance advisories for `paste`, `zbus_names`, `zvariant` and `zvariant_derive`; these remain separate follow-up work. The unchanged dependency audit gate still applies to the release source.
- The project license remains unspecified in these packages; this release does not add a license grant. Included third-party notices retain their respective terms and source provenance.

The generated changelog below describes committed software changes. Its fix summaries do not replace the physical-device and listening acceptance listed above.
